name: Even Better Sydney Gathering 2022
information:
## There is no 3x3x3 Cube at this competition, the main event is 4x4x4 Cube
We are actively working on organising more competitions some of which will include 3x3x3 Cube. Check out the page of [upcoming competitions in New South Wales](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=%E2%9C%93&region=all&search=New+South+Wales&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) to find the most up-to-date list.
